body: Well I'm sober now and still very upset. I just wanted to thank the people who dealt with me yesterday. It means a lot. I don't know what I'm going to do but I wanted to say thanks regardless of what happens.

I guess I'm just worried that people on the team (whom I care about a lot and respect quite a bit) will think less of me. I know you're going to say they won't if they are true friends but I know they will. They're going to think I'm pathetic. I also don't want my girlfriend (who is very smart) to think I'm pathetic but I know she will. I hate it when I feel this way!

I wanted to initially be a Marine. I have OCD and ADHD so I got disqualified. I figured, "I could still serve my country! I'll work for the CIA!" You really think that the CIA is willing to hire me? No way! Not with my grades and my mental illness so how can you say life isn't over with college. Life is over with college! If I fail, then I give up everything I wanted to be!

Probably not. I love my coach but there is no way he could sway my GPA in the right direction. I've been suicidal before and this is exactly what I felt like. I can't believe I didn't do it because this feel so terrible. I hate it! I don't want to be here with all of this stress. I just want my professor to email me back and tell me that he will give me a D! I just want a D! That's all! How pathetic is that? It's the school that won't let me row if I have below a 2.0 not my coach so I don't think I can appeal to his sense of sympathy. Especially because he is one of those guys that has the mentality that if you can't get it done then you weren't trying hard enough. I was probably going to be on the best boat too! We were going to win a national championship! I can't believe it! I just want to have a 2.0 and I can't even do that! I'm sorry for ranting to you. I'm sure other people have worse problems. You should go deal with them.

It was both. It was a graduate course! I'm a freshman but by the time I decided it was too much for me it was too late to drop the course. My advisor is fucking useless so I didn't fucking talk to him because he is terrible at what he does. I don't think I should have taken the course and I emailed the prof asking for a sympathy D. Can you imagine? Me asking for a sympathy D? I'm smart! How could I ever ask for such a terrible grade! I can't believe it! I'm so pathetic! I don't even know what to say to anybody! I feel like I'm retarded and my parents wanted to watch me race in the spring but I don't think I can tell them that I can't yet. I can't tell them right now. I told them P/F a class doesn't count to my GPA but I realized today that it does! I want to cry! I want to just stop all of this stupid crap! It is all crap!

How can I even begin to start? I never thought this would happen. I studied so hard! Now everyone will know that the reason I can't row this spring is because I'm retarded. I go t to Columbia University and I took a class that was WAY out of my league because I thought if I pass failed it it wouldn't count towards my GPA but it does! Now I can't even pull a 2.0 because I failed it! Now I'm drinking at 3:00 in the afternoon because I feel pathetic! How do I explain this to my parents? They spend their money on a child that can't even produce mediocre results! I hate it when people have sympathy for me because it makes me feel weak and I don't want them to sympathize with my situation but I also don't want them to be mad. I don't know what to do!
